%N Axxxxx-c4 Number of free polyplets (A030222) with n cells whose symmetry group is exactly the cyclic group of order 4 generated by a 90-degree rotation (chiral; no reflection).
%C Axxxxx-c4 A polyplet (polyking) is a set of unit cells joined through shared edges or corners. The square symmetry group D4 partitions the free polyplets A030222 into 8 classes by exact symmetry group; this is one of them. The five reflection-containing classes (axial, diagonal, two-axis, two-diagonal, full) sum to A030234 (bilaterally symmetric); the other three (asymmetric, 180-degree, 90-degree) sum to A030235. Polyplet analogue of A144553 (polyominoes). - _Jason H Parker_, 2026
%F Axxxxx-c4 Obtained via the table of marks of the square symmetry group D4 from the counts of fixed polyplets (A006770) invariant under each subgroup. The 8 symmetry classes partition A030222(n), and the five reflection classes sum to A030234(n); both checked for all n <= 19.
%Y Axxxxx-c4 Cf. A030222 (free polyplets), A030234, A030235, A006770 (fixed polyplets), A144553 (polyomino analogue).
%K Axxxxx-c4 nonn,more
%O Axxxxx-c4 1,8
%A Axxxxx-c4 _Jason H Parker_, 2026
